description: Run a Docker container as a Dagster asset via dagster-docker.

outputs.description: Run a Docker container as a Dagster asset via dagster-docker.

entrypoint.label: Entrypoint
entrypoint.description: Override the container ENTRYPOINT (separate from command/CMD).

registry.label: Registry
registry.description: Credentials for a non-public Docker registry to pull `image` from. Keys: 'url', 'username', 'password' (dagster-docker's execute_docker_container 'registry' param).

container_kwargs.label: Container Kwargs
container_kwargs.description: Raw key-value pairs passed straight through to the Docker Python SDK's containers.create() (https://docker-py.readthedocs.io/en/stable/containers.html) -- e.g. volumes, labels, working_dir, user, mem_limit. Not simplified into dedicated fields since the available options vary too much. Do NOT put 'name' here -- dagster-docker's own execute_docker_container always passes its own 'name=' first, so a 'name' key here raises 'got multiple values for keyword argument'; use container_name instead.

container_name.label: Container Name
container_name.description: A fixed container name, instead of dagster-docker's auto-derived hash(run_id + op_name). Not possible via container_kwargs (see its description) -- setting this switches to this component's own direct container-creation path instead of delegating to execute_docker_container.

force_pull.label: Force Pull
force_pull.description: Pull `image` unconditionally before creating the container, even if a (possibly stale) copy is already cached locally. The delegate path only pulls on a cache MISS (docker.errors.ImageNotFound); this explicitly re-pulls every run.

auto_remove.label: Auto Remove
auto_remove.description: Remove the container automatically once it exits (the real Docker auto_remove flag), instead of leaving a stopped container behind for later inspection.

mounts.label: Mounts
mounts.description: Docker volume/bind mounts, as a list of docker.types.Mount constructor kwargs, e.g. [{target: '/data', source: 'my-vol', type: 'volume'}] or [{target: '/host-dir', source: '/local/path', type: 'bind', read_only: true}].

ports.label: Ports
ports.description: Container->host port publishing, as the real Docker SDK 'ports' dict, e.g. {'8080/tcp': 8080}. Incompatible with network_mode='host' and, per the Docker SDK, with the single `network` field already set here when publishing requires default bridge networking -- test your specific combination.

docker_base_url.label: Docker Base Url
docker_base_url.description: Connect to a non-default Docker daemon (e.g. 'tcp://remote-host:2376') instead of the local daemon resolved by DOCKER_HOST/the default socket. Setting this switches to this component's own direct container-creation path, since dagster_docker.execute_docker_container always uses docker.client.from_env() with no override hook.

tls_ca_cert_path.label: Tls Ca Cert Path
tls_ca_cert_path.description: Path to a CA cert file, for connecting to a TLS-secured Docker daemon (usually set together with docker_base_url). Setting this switches to the direct path.

tls_client_cert_path.label: Tls Client Cert Path
tls_client_cert_path.description: Path to a client cert file for TLS client auth. Requires tls_client_key_path too.

tls_client_key_path.label: Tls Client Key Path
tls_client_key_path.description: Path to a client key file for TLS client auth. Requires tls_client_cert_path too.

tls_verify.label: Tls Verify
tls_verify.description: Verify the Docker daemon's TLS certificate. Only meaningful when docker_base_url/tls_ca_cert_path/tls_client_cert_path are set.

retrieve_output.label: Retrieve Output
retrieve_output.description: Capture the container's combined stdout/stderr and attach it as asset metadata ('container_output', truncated to the last 4000 characters). The delegate path only prints container output to the run log, with no way to also hand it back to the caller as a value -- enabling this switches to this component's own direct container-creation path, which keeps a handle to the container after it exits.

name: DockerContainerAsset
